newsitem.title: UK: M&C Saatchi launches Packard Bell TV ads in Europe.
newsitem.headline: M&C Saatchi launches Packard Bell TV ads in Europe.

text.p: M&C Saatchi on Thursday said it is unveiling a multi-million dollar television advertising campaign for U.S. computer firm Packard Bell in Europe this week.

The advertising campaign, which is similar to a television ad campaign that M&C Saatchi launched for Packard Bell in the U.S. last month, will be unveiled this week in Britain, France, Italy, Spain, Ireland and South Africa. It will roll out across the rest of Europe in 1997, the advertising agency said.

The campaign, which includes one 60-second spot and three 30-second commercials, is aimed at positioning the Packard Bell personal computer for the home market. Each advert ends with the line, "Wouldn't you rather be at home?"
In April Packard Bell merged with Zenith Data Systems, the U.S. unit of Cie des Machines Bull. Japan's NEC Corp owns 40 percent of Packard Bell.
